utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Last I heard, it’s coming together nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can ask around for any fresh details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Tess—could you check if we’re still short on tape, screwdrivers, or nails? I can help fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and see if we’re still short on tape, screwdrivers, or nails. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Could you bring a short list of needed repairs and ask a few neighbors what they need most? That’d really help me get the drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can put together a short list and ask a few neighbors what’s most urgent. I’ll circle back with whatever I hear, especially about the gate or faucet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. Bring it by the community hall bulletin board when you have it, and I’ll add it to the repair drive notes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds promising, but can you confirm where the drop-off is and when it ends?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the exact drop-off spot or end time yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me—I can coordinate around the school schedule. Let me know what supplies or boxes you still need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just filler and patch mix for the edge cracks, and maybe a few boxes to mark the area. If you can check the cracks with me first, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can check the cracks with you first and bring a few boxes to mark the area. I’ll also coordinate around school so I’m there Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring over some filler and patch mix later today. If you want, I’ll also check the edge cracks with you before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — that would help a lot. Can you also let me know what time you’re coming over so I can make sure I’m home?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can come by around 4 this afternoon. I’ll bring the filler and patch mix, and we can check the edge cracks together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure we’ve got the exact collection point yet. I can ask around and let you know as soon as I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — let me know as soon as you hear, and I’ll tell the others I’m still planning to swing by and help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’ll ask around and pass it on once I know. Hopefully we can keep it simple and not haul things to the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by a bit late and help where I can. If you still need tape or nails, I can try to bring some.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—4 works for me. Just let me know if the repair drive location changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll keep an eye out and bring tape or nails if I can. See you at 4 unless anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the screwdrivers, hammer, and some duct tape. I’ll also see if I have a few sturdy boxes to spare.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus — I’ll check at home for any extra screws and tape and bring what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that’ll really help. I’ll set my tools aside and bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll make a short list of needed repairs and ask a few neighbors what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — that sounds helpful. If I notice the reminder, I’ll try to stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — just let me know what you notice, and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, a few screwdrivers, and some spare nails. If you can bring any of that, it’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see if anyone can bring tape, screwdrivers, or spare nails. I’ll ask around right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that’d really help. If you hear back on any of the tape, screwdrivers, or nails, let me know and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, I’ll note it at the community hall bulletin board. I’ll also check the other repair drive spots and let you know if I find any differences.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — thanks for checking. Let me know if you spot anything, and I can help spread the word once we know what's different.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfectly fine, Uli — even a small help is appreciated. We’re now doing the repair drive on Sunday at the community center, so just come by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday when I can and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still in, I just want the drop-off details confirmed first. Do we know exactly where the repair drive is collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, it’s at the community hall on Saturday morning. I’m bringing tape and a screwdriver, and I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that works for me. I’ll plan to bring my things to the community hall Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll ask around a bit and see what folks actually need fixed. If you want me to mention anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, please tell them to bring tools, tape, hammers, and any spare screws or nails if they’ve got them. I’ll swing by for a bit and remind a few others too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll spread the word about tools, tape, hammers, and any spare screws or nails. Thanks, and I’ll let you know what people say they need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’m still gathering the details, so before I help more, can you remind me what’s still needed and when the repair drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the exact time, but we’ve already got tape and screws covered. If anything else comes up — especially for the gate or faucet — I can help connect people.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll keep asking what’s still needed, especially for the gate or faucet, and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? It looks like it’s really happening today, not just talk. I’d still check with the organizers, but there’s been enough activity to make me think it’s on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds like it’s on today. If you can, bring a short list of needed repairs and ask a few neighbors what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll jot down a short list and ask around for what folks need most. Then I’ll bring it by and let the organizers know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t checked yet, but I can swing by and see what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Could you swing by and let me know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — just a quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. We’re still collecting basic tools, strong tape, hammers, and spare screws or nails if you have any.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the repair drive for Sunday at the community center and keep track of the updated supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I can only help a little, so if you keep it simple, I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll keep it simple. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If you make it by, just knock softly and we’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already started telling folks, and I’ll keep spreading the word. If you hear any updates, let me know and I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll keep sharing the word around the neighborhood. If they need extra help or supplies, send it my way and I’ll pass it on fast.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sounds like it’s getting a few more donations than expected. I’m a bit forgetful, but I can help keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. If you notice they still need filler or patch mix, let me know and I can bring some by later today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll keep an eye out for filler or patch mix and let you know if I hear they need any more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve been keeping an eye on the supplies for the repair drive, so tell me what you still need and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — I can help work around the school schedule, and Saturday at 9 should be okay for me. Let me know what supplies are still missing, and I’ll see if I can bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Faye. I’ll check what we’re still short on and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know the collection point yet, or should we ask around first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s ask around first. I haven’t got the collection point yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, let’s ask around first so we don’t haul everything to the wrong place.
